dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with free-format source directives ($set sourceformat"free"), htmlpp preprocessor, external-form CGI linkage, and OO repository clause (class Utils). Likely running under Micro Focus Visual COBOL or Net Express targeting a web/CGI environment. Portuguese-language Brazilian business system (PW prefix suggests Prowork/EFD-style ERP).

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian ERP/distribution system - report of unfactured comodatos (loan equipment not yet billed) for a given period, with CSV export capability. Likely part of a Prowork or similar Brazilian ERP suite.
purpose.summary: This program (PW03241R) generates a report of 'Comodatos não Faturados' (loan items not billed in the period). It reads indexed files for clients, sectors, items, fiscal notes, and comodato records, then produces a formatted report and/or CSV output listing unbilled comodato items with date, client, item, quantity, and reason codes.

notable_features: repository clause with OO class reference
CSV export support with delimiter constants
43 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; procedure division body not visible beyond section header. Program is clearly part of a larger Brazilian ERP system with consistent naming conventions (PW/PC prefixes). The 'online-cics' program_type is approximate - this is actually a CGI web program (external-form, htmlpp), not CICS, but no better enum value exists. File decoded with latin-1 due to Portuguese characters (ã, ç, etc.).
